criterion.question: Given the premise, is the hypothesis definitely true (entailed)?
criterion.notes: Adapted from metaeval/chaos-mnli-ambiguity (ChaosNLI MNLI subset, 100 annotators per item). humanLabel is pass when at least half the annotators chose entailment. reviewerDisagreement is true when the entailment share is between 0.3 and 0.7. softLabel holds the entailment share. Comparison sample: the next 500 items in the same seed-101 order, disjoint from the 200-case set.

criterion.question: Given the user's turns, is response A the better answer than response B at the judged turn (input.judged_turn; earlier turns are context)?
criterion.notes: Adapted from lmsys/mt_bench_human_judgments (expert pairwise votes, multiple judges per pair). humanLabel is the majority vote; reviewerDisagreement is true when judges were not unanimous (including any tie vote). Comparison sample: the next 500 pairs in the same seed-103 order, disjoint from the 150-pair set.
